environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. The Flask app listens directly on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP/443 to TCP/8080. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database contains user records including api_key column with production API keys.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough mode (no HTTP inspection)
config.database: SQLite on local EBS volume, users table populated with api_key values
